title: Kobold
html:
Kobolds are a type of non-playable Humanoid race in Baldur's Gate 3.

“
Clever but craven reptilians that overcome their physical ineptitude by banding together.
„
— In-game racial description

About Kobolds

Kobolds resemble small scaley lizards that stand upright, and can be found at the Rosymorn Monastery and in Baldur's Gate.

Racial Features

Base Racial Speed
9m / 30ft
Size
Small
Pack Tactics
When an ally is within 3 m (10 ft) of your target and is not  Incapacitated, your  Attack Rolls against the target have  Advantage.
Sunlight Sensitivity
While in sunlight, this creature has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Perception checks that rely on sight.
Darkvision
Can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft).

Tactician Only

Evasion
Your agility lets you dodge out of the way of certain spells. When a spell or effect would deal half damage on a successful  Dexterity Saving Throw, it deals no damage if you succeed, and only half damage if you fail.
